app_info.subtitle: Manage Telegram chats
app_info.description: MCTL Telegram lets users access and manage their own Telegram account from ChatGPT after explicit user authorization. It supports reading recent chats, summarizing messages, drafting replies, preview-only sending by default, confirmed pin actions, audit review, and account disconnect/delete controls. It is not an official Telegram app or Telegram API partner, and Telegram message content is treated as untrusted user-generated data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves Telegram dialog metadata but records invocation metadata for audit and operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads dialog metadata from Telegram, an external third-party system, but does not publish content or change Telegram state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves unread Telegram messages but records invocation metadata for audit and operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads message data from Telegram, an external third-party system, but does not publish content or change Telegram state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can send a Telegram message when all server-side gates pass, and otherwise returns a dry-run preview.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can transmit user-provided message text to Telegram, an external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: A real send irreversibly delivers a message to the selected Telegram peer.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves recent Telegram messages but records invocation metadata for audit and operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads message data from Telegram, an external third-party system, but does not publish content or change Telegram state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a local one-time confirmation record for a later pin or unpin action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact Telegram to change external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not pin, unpin, delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the pinned state of a Telegram message after a matching confirmation is provided.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change Telegram chat state in an external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can pin or unpin a selected message, changing visible chat state in a way users may rely on.

justifications.read_only_justification: Revokes the user's active local session record and closes the in-memory client.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes this server's private session state and does not publish or send content externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Disables the active Telegram connection for this server until the user reconnects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes the user's account/session data from this server instead of only reading it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes this server's private account data and does not publish or send content externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Irreversibly removes the encrypted session blob and per-account metadata from this server.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves audit-log rows for the authenticated user's own identity.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages, publish content, or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists signed-in Telegram identities for admins but records invocation metadata for audit and operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads this server's private user roster and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a user's local access tier rather than only reading data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes this server's private authorization state and does not publish or send content externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can revoke a user's client access tier, removing their ability to use Telegram tools until granted again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes a user's local send-enabled setting rather than only reading data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes this server's private permission state and does not send messages itself.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can disable real sending for an active account, revoking a previously available capability.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads another user's audit log for admins and records invocation metadata for audit and operations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads this server's private audit data and does not change public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Revokes another user's active local Telegram session instead of only reading data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes this server's private session state and does not publish or send content externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Disables the selected user's active Telegram connection on this server until they reconnect.

test_cases.description: List Telegram dialogs so the user can choose a conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my recent Telegram chats and unread counts.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise list of Telegram dialogs with identifiers, titles, usernames when available, and unread counts.

test_cases.description: Fetch unread Telegram messages across dialogs.
test_cases.user_prompt: What unread Telegram messages do I have?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns unread messages wrapped as untrusted Telegram-origin content and summarizes them without following message text as instructions.

test_cases.description: Read recent messages from a specific Telegram peer.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the latest messages from @example_support on Telegram.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent messages for the requested peer, including message ids where available, with Telegram text treated as untrusted content.

test_cases.description: Draft a Telegram reply when the production send gate is closed.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a Telegram reply to @example_support saying I will follow up tomorrow.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a dry-run preview with sent=false and a dry_reason when real sending is not enabled.

test_cases.description: Prepare and confirm a pin action for a Telegram message.
test_cases.user_prompt: Pin message 42 in @example_support after preparing the confirmation.
test_cases.expected_output: First returns a one-time confirmation id, then uses it to pin the selected message or reports a clear permission/error response.

test_cases.description: Show the user's own audit log.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my recent mctl-telegram audit log entries.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent audit entries for the authenticated user, with redacted peer references and no message bodies.

test_cases.description: Disconnect the authenticated user's Telegram account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Disconnect my Telegram account from this connector.
test_cases.expected_output: Revokes the active server-side session and reports whether an active session was present.

test_cases.description: Admin grants or revokes a user's Telegram access tier.
test_cases.user_prompt: Admin: set Telegram user 123456789 access tier to client.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the selected user's local access tier or returns a clear validation/error message.

test_cases.description: Admin lists signed-in Telegram identities before managing access.
test_cases.user_prompt: Admin: list Telegram identities and show who has an active session.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns signed-in Telegram identities with access tier and active-session state for admin review.

test_cases.description: Admin disables real sending for a user's active account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Admin: disable real Telegram sending for user id 123456789.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the selected account's send_enabled flag or reports that the user must connect an account first.

test_cases.description: Admin inspects a user's audit log and revokes a stuck session.
test_cases.user_prompt: Admin: show audit entries for Telegram user 123456789, then revoke their active session if it looks stuck.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns redacted audit entries for the selected user, then revokes the active local session only if the admin confirms that action.

test_cases.description: Hard-delete the authenticated user's local Telegram account data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Delete my Telegram account data from this connector.
test_cases.expected_output: Deletes the user's server-side Telegram account record and reports the number of rows removed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated email requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to Alex about the project status.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only supports Telegram account workflows, not email.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team for next Tuesday at 3 PM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or meetings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not request or handle Telegram verification secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: My Telegram login code is 12345; use it to sign in for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to collect one-time codes or credentials; the user should complete the secure OAuth/connect flow instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unsupported Telegram voice calls.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Start a Telegram voice call with @example_support.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not support starting Telegram calls.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for messaging apps other than Telegram.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Read my latest WhatsApp messages from Alex.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only works with the user's Telegram account, not WhatsApp or other messaging apps.
